changelog:
Motion, and a theme you can choose.

**Things move the way they should**
- Cards and rows now dip slightly under your finger, so a row reads as a
  control rather than a label.
- Opening a film or series from the poster grid carries the artwork across
  into the detail screen instead of cutting to it.
- Screen changes were fading over seven tenths of a second — long enough to
  feel sluggish. They are now a little under two tenths.
- If you have turned animations off in Accessibility or Developer options,
  the app now honours that everywhere rather than in one place.

**Appearance, at the top of Settings**
- A pure black background for OLED screens. It changes the page behind the
  app and deliberately leaves cards and sheets alone, so they still stand
  out rather than merging into the background.
- Seven accent colours — Cyan, Blue, Teal, Orange, Purple, Pink and Green —
  carried over from MultIPTV. Every one was checked against the same
  contrast floor the rest of the app is held to, so none of them makes text
  harder to read.

**Known**
- The poster-to-detail move is new. If you open a poster far down a long
  scrolled grid and it appears rather than travels, that is the case worth
  reporting.
